outcome: maternal morbidity (wound infections, adjacent structure injuries, re-laparotomies, other complications)
cohort: 162 women who underwent peripartum hysterectomy at Wolaita Sodo University Comprehensive Specialized Hospital, Southern Ethiopia.
finding: Peripartum hysterectomy (PH) occurred at a rate of 5.2 per 1,000 deliveries, primarily due to uterine rupture, and was a major contributor to maternal morbidity and mortality.
mod_finding: Most peripartum hysterectomies (87%) were performed following cesarean delivery.
cross-section timing: Data was collected for events occurring between March 2017 and April 2023.
